subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Investigative scientists are researchers who work to uncover scientific misconduct and fraudulent research practices in academic institutions.
• Dr. Honoka Ikeda was an investigative scientist who examined allegations of data fabrication at Riverside University's biology department.
• She conducted interviews with graduate students, laboratory technicians, and department faculty members.
• She analyzed hundreds of research files, including raw data sets, laboratory notebooks, and published papers.
• Her report submitted to the university in 2023 revealed systematic manipulation of experimental results.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the thoroughness of Dr. Honoka Ikeda's investigation of the biology department. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Dr. Honoka Ikeda, who investigated allegations at Riverside University's biology department, was an investigative scientist (a researcher who works to uncover scientific misconduct in academic institutions).
choices.B: As part of her investigation of the biology department, investigative scientist Dr. Honoka Ikeda conducted interviews with university personnel.
choices.C: Submitted to the university in 2023, investigative scientist Dr. Honoka Ikeda's report revealed systematic manipulation of experimental results in the biology department.
choices.D: Dr. Honoka Ikeda not only interviewed graduate students, laboratory technicians, and department faculty but also analyzed hundreds of research files, including raw data and laboratory notebooks.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer. It describes Ikeda's investigation and the lengths she went to complete it.
